notes: EXAMPLE, VERIFY BEFORE USE. Written from memory of public information, NOT from the official page: pmkisan.gov.in could not be reached when this file was written.
Check the amount, the instalments and the exclusion list against https://pmkisan.gov.in/ before trusting anything here.
occupation = farmer is a simplification. The official test is whether the family holds cultivable land, so a landholder with another job may be wrongly marked not eligible.
not_encoded: Exclusions (as remembered, unverified): institutional landholders; holders of constitutional posts; serving or retired government officers and employees (lower grades excepted); pensioners above a monthly pension limit; people who paid income tax in the last assessment year; registered doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects.
Registration and e-KYC steps on the PM-KISAN portal.
Which family members count as one 'family' for the benefit.

version.benefit_text_en: Example, verify before use: income support of Rs 6,000 a year for landholding farmer families, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 straight into the bank account.
version.benefit_text_hi: उदाहरण, उपयोग से पहले जाँचें: भूमि वाले किसान परिवारों को साल में 6,000 रुपये की सहायता, 2,000 रुपये की तीन किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में।
